#### Notable Changes

- fusemanager: remove direct imports of logrus ([#​2411](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2411)), thanks to [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah)
- github.com/Microsoft/go-winio v0.6.3 ([#​2412](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2412)), thanks to [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah)
- verifier: separate pacakges to reduce import dependencies ([#​2418](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2418))
- analyzer: replace ctr signal helpers with local implementations ([#​2409](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2409)), thanks to [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah)
- verifier: fix hang issues ([#​2422](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2422))
- move analyzer package to cmd module ([#​2410](https://redirect.github.com/containerd/stargz-snapshotter/issues/2410)), thanks to [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah)

</details>
